content: Session env on FeralOS = the Chimera turnstile pattern, verified already in place: pam_env (/etc/pam.d/turnstiled) -> pam_getenvlist -> user dinit; upstream backend sources /etc/profile (profile.d reaches user services); session scripts dinitctl setenv; Artix dinit-userservd fork imports NOTHING (anti-pattern). elogind never sets XDG_DATA_DIRS

portal-order pattern: gate a supervised portal daemon on its peers' D-Bus names (NameHasOwner poll) before exec — otherwise D-Bus ACTIVATION spawns an unsupervised twin and the supervised instance loses the name race (xdg-document-portal exit 20 = on_name_lost). dbus-wait-for is a readiness notifier (execs immediately), NOT an ordering gate
